# Ajtrix Technologies

> Ajtrix Technologies is a web design, branding, digital marketing, custom software, digital transformation consulting, and presentation design studio operating from Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India and Chicago, Illinois, USA.

- Website: https://www.ajtrix.com/
- Email: hello@ajtrix.com
- Offices: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India | Chicago, Illinois, USA
- Markets Served: India (Chennai, Bangalore), United States (Chicago, Illinois), Singapore, Middle East
- Socials: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ajtrixtech/), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ajtrix/)

## Core Services
- [Web & Digital Experiences](https://www.ajtrix.com/services/web-digital-experiences): Custom websites, corporate sites, e-commerce stores, landing pages, UI/UX design, 3D/interactive web builds, migrations, and optimization.
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://www.ajtrix.com/services/digital-marketing-growth): Digital strategy, social media management, reels & short-form video, copywriting, Meta Ads, Google Ads, analytics, and local SEO/Google Business Profile optimization.
- [Branding & Creative](https://www.ajtrix.com/services/branding-creative): Brand strategy, logo design, visual identity systems, brand guidelines, rebranding, ad creatives, brochures, and company profiles.
- [Custom Software & Products](https://www.ajtrix.com/services/custom-software-products): Custom web applications, SaaS & MVP development, CRM/ERP systems, client portals, admin dashboards, booking & inventory systems, and API/payment integrations.
- [Digital Transformation & Consulting](https://www.ajtrix.com/services/digital-transformation-consulting): Technology consulting, digital transformation roadmaps, business/process digitization, legacy system modernization, and rollout consulting.
- [Business & Presentation Design](https://www.ajtrix.com/services/business-presentation-design): Investor pitch decks, corporate & sales presentations, business proposals, company profiles, and reports.
